summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting results of Iovance Biotherapeutics' 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Shareholders voted on seven routine governance and compensation proposals, including director elections, executive compensation, ratification of auditor, and approval of equity plan amendments and authorized share increase. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report of shareholder votes and does not constitute a special situation as defined.
